blocks.text: Corruption 1–2 generally uses a finer 320×180 logical grid. Corruption 3 generally uses 240×135. Corruption 4 generally uses 192×108. Corruption 5 generally uses 160×90. Mixed-corruption sites may vary by region. All logical grids are enlarged to 1920×1080 with nearest-neighbor scaling, so greater corruption remains visibly more pixelated at full-screen size.
